item.text: The server correctly saves unchecked tasks, but the browser submits a full-page navigation for every toggle. A quick filter change or reload can interrupt that submission. I’ll save completion in the background and make filter changes wait for pending saves.

The new regression test runs the page’s JavaScript against the server, verifies that filtering waits for an uncheck to save, and confirms the task remains unchecked after restart. It also checks recovery from a failed save. No browser runner is available here, so I haven’t rerun the PM’s Playwright test.
